function to_roman(number)
    result = ""
    for (value, symbol) in [
        (1000, "M"),
        (900, "CM"),
        (500, "D"),
        (400, "CD"),
        (100, "C"),
        (90, "XC"),
        (50, "L"),
        (40, "XL"),
        (10, "X"),
        (9, "IX"),
        (5, "V"),
        (4, "IV"),
        (1, "I"),
    ]
        while number >= value
            result *= symbol
            number -= value
        end
    end
    return result
function from_roman(roman)
    table = Dict('I'=>1, 'V'=>5, 'X'=>10, 'L'=>50, 'C'=>100, 'D'=>500, 'M'=>1000)
    total = 0
    for i = 1:length(roman)
        value = table[roman[i]]
        total += i < length(roman) && value < table[roman[i+1]] ? -value : value
    end
    return total
    roman = to_roman(number)
    println(number, " -> ", roman, " -> ", from_roman(roman))
